dedupe_keys.name: dr congo electricity sector indicators and annual reports are production by source 2020 2025 installed capacity avoided emissions and operator reports

description: The electricity regulator of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (ARE) publishes a sector indicators page and annual reports. On 2026-09-29 the indicators page gave the 2025 headline figures (total production 16,451.31 GWh, of which hydroelectric 15,362.19 GWh, thermal 705.02 GWh and photovoltaic 384.09 GWh; installed capacity about 4,133 MW; about 10.79 MtCO2e of emissions avoided by renewables) and a table of annual production by source for 2020 to 2025 (12,460.20 GWh in 2020). It also sets out the indicator families the regulator is filling progressively from its annual reports and operator returns: service quality (SAIFI, SAIDI, CAIDI, incidents, network availability), market structure (shares, imports, exports, HHI), transmission and distribution (losses, line lengths, substation and interconnector capacity), access and consumption. The site also offers the ARE annual report 2025 and operators' annual reports (Virunga Energies 2023) as downloads. Coverage: national, DR Congo. Format and access: web tables and PDF reports in French, free. Licence: not stated. Caveats: many listed indicators have no values yet; the avoided-emission figures rest on the baseline scenario of the annual report. Simulation uses: capacity planning and resilience of a hydro-dominated grid. Related records: the DRC telecom regulator's observatory (data-arptc-drc-telecom-market-observatory-reports).
